text: Unit/integration tests for: channel→contract→provider routing isolation, quota-ledger separation, read-only boundary enforcement (advisor cannot mutate), idempotency. - A test asserting `openai-codex/*` is never selected for Advisor-channel input. - Log checks: `storage/logs/app.log`, `storage/logs/error.log`, `.ai/harpp-wake.log`, ideation ledger. `php -l` / `node --check` on touched files.
